extracted.summary: A partner at Hollis Solicitors enquires about a £19,500 litigation loan for a client (the mother) in divorce proceedings where around £263,500 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's divorce proceedings. We have noted the £19,500 requested and the approximately £263,500 of property and pension assets in dispute. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and the court involved, the current stage of proceedings and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets offered as security along with your client's contact details and identification. We will send our criteria and application form to you by email. A member of the team will follow up once we have reviewed the information provided.
